goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

current_best.notes: Iteration 8 (kernel v16) doubled context (block_size 256->512, token_local_window 64->128) AND scaled data 10M->30M chars. Clean 40/40 TPU run (~58 min), val_bpc 1.8869 @ E40 — big new best. Gain vs iter-7 (-0.4009 BPC) is confounded between context doubling and data scaling; context was the primary lever per plan. Tail still slowly improving (E37->E40: 1.8901 -> 1.8869) so flattening but not saturated. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 (d768/E20) -> 2.3023 (d768/E40) -> 2.2878 (d1024/E40) -> 1.8869 (d1024/ctx512/30M/E40).

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-9 (in flight): context doubling round 2 — block_size 512->1024, stride 256->512, token_local_window 128->256, keep d_model=1024 / 30M chars / 40 epochs. Context scaling validated (iter-8: 256->512 + data gave -0.40 BPC); the hypothesis says another doubling should give further gains. Estimated runtime ~1.5-2h (steps/epoch halve, per-step cost ~4x for chunk-chunk attention). Watch HBM (16GiB/chip) at block 1024.
If context 1024 helps, the remaining big lever is joint context+capacity (d_model 1024->1536, chunk_dec_layers 8->12) via the online W&B sweep (RUN_MODE=sweep_online_single_agent).
Data scaling (10M->30M) was confounded with context in iter-8; isolate it: an apples-to-apples 30M/ctx512 vs 10M/ctx512 comparison would quantify the data contribution.
Re-enable the online W&B sweep over d_model/chunk_dec_layers/lr once the context experiment is green.
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress (kernel reruns can resume from the last checkpoint).
Evaluate ALiBi for chunk-level attention (currently forced off in TF due to slow impl).
Add a true text8 evaluation path (alternative corpus to cross-validate generalization).
